data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 刀剑图录
data.description: 蕾娜在书店翻到一本刀剑图录，指尖停在刀镡的插图旁。她侧过头，想把新看到的细节讲给身边的人听。
data.action: 在书店翻阅刀剑图录，指尖停在刀镡插图旁，侧头向身边人兴奋讲解
data.promptProse: Inside a quiet wood-shelved bookshop on a bright afternoon, Lena stands in her white kimono top and red pleated hakama-style skirt holding open a thick illustrated sword catalogue. With one fingertip resting excitedly beside a detailed drawing of a carved sword guard, she turns her head eagerly to share the discovery with her companion. Warm afternoon window light falls across the open pages, stacked paperbacks, and her braided low ponytail.
data.animaCaption: Standing among the wooden bookshop shelves in her white kimono and red pleated skirt, Lena holds open an illustrated sword catalogue and points eagerly to a sword-guard diagram as she turns to speak. Afternoon window light brightens the open pages and nearby shelves.
